output: I built the Relay operations dashboard with four files in the task directory. The HTML uses a semantic nav rail, top status bar, and main column with metrics, throughput panel, and incident split. The CSS defines a calm dark palette (`--bg`, `--bg-1/2/3`) with a single cyan accent (`--accent`) and desaturated severity colors, applies tabular numerals everywhere a number appears, uses compact spacing and tight 2–4 px radii, and reflows at1100/880/640/390 px breakpoints so the table becomes stacked labeled rows with no horizontal scroll on a 390 px viewport. The JS fetches `DATA.json` (with an embedded mirror fallback for `file://`), renders the metrics with directional deltas, draws the 24-hour throughput as an inline SVG line/area chart with a peak marker and hour ticks, and runs the filterable incident table with severity chips, free-text search, row selection (click or Enter/Space), a working Acknowledge action that flips status and announces confirmation through `aria-live`, plus an empty state with a clear-filters button. RESPONSE.md documents the hierarchy, interaction model, accessibility choices (skip link, focus rings, keyboard-activatable rows, reduced-motion handling, color independence), and responsive breakpoints. All deliverables are complete: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`, and `RESPONSE.md` are written into `/Users/arda/projects/agent-eval-runs/agent-eval-mcode-m3/11-frontend-operations/`; I did not run a browser to confirm rendering, only code review. Model: MiniMax-M3.
